never explained why this server is synchronous while its sibling is not.
States that there is no router: the tool descriptions are the routing
logic, and nothing is offloaded here by design, since wrapping a
seconds-long local call in a job store would be pure overhead.

Adds a three-way table for choosing between this server, codex-offload
and the calling model itself, and an explicit account of what the label
validation does and does not catch — it rejects malformed and hedged
replies but cannot catch a confidently wrong one, which the none escape
hatch narrows without closing.

91c8448586fa16275ad8e2e65b215b106daeafeagise87gijstromp@planet.nlgise87gijstromp@planet.nl17845498952026-07-20T14:18:15+02:0069637bd6d7fc308c4f4e1e355ceff2daf4f6ca75Let local_classify report that no label fitsValidation caught malformed and hedged replies but not confidently wrong
ones, and a small model asked to choose always chooses: classifying "the
weather in Rotterdam is mild today" into [database-migration,
authentication-bug] returned authentication-bug with matched:true.

Offer the model a none option unless allowNone:false, reported as
declined:true and never as a match. On by default, because opt-in would
leave the unsound behaviour as the default. Suppressed when the caller's
labels already contain none, so there is only ever one way to say
nothing-fits.

Verified against the live model: the weather case now declines, a real
authentication bug with the same labels still classifies correctly, so
the hatch does not make the model shy. It narrows the failure rather than
closing it -- the model can still decline wrongly or mislabel within the
set.

69637bd6d7fc308c4f4e1e355ceff2daf4f6ca75gise87gijstromp@planet.nlgise87gijstromp@planet.nl17845494592026-07-20T14:10:59+02:00Add local-llm MCP serverA synchronous companion to codex-offload: prompts a local model through
Ollama and returns the answer in the same turn. The split is deliberate --
codex-offload exists because agentic jobs take minutes and must not block,
while a local 7B answers in seconds, so a job store and polling would be
pure overhead there.

Three tools: local_ask for freeform text, local_classify for constrained
triage, local_models to see what is on disk. No file access, no command
execution, no memory between calls.

local_classify validates the reply against the caller's label set and
returns matched:false rather than guessing, mirroring how codex-offload
pairs Codex's self-report with an independent git diff. It is generous
about form but refuses hedged replies and substring matches. It cannot
catch a confidently wrong label; that limit is documented.

Measured on this hardware: ~34 tok/s for a 3B, ~16 tok/s for a 7B on CPU.
Enabling the integrated GPU makes generation slower, since it shares
system memory bandwidth -- recorded so nobody assumes it is free speed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
